results.name: input_state_initialize
results.evidence: Zeroes a 0x97c-dword block at DAT_00710328 (the control-binding tables), resets DAT_0087a460 (last-active control) and the QueryPerformanceCounter-based time base DAT_00712538, then sets the input-enabled flags 00712541/00712542.
results.summary: One-time input subsystem initializer that clears all binding tables and (re)establishes the QueryPerformanceCounter-based millisecond time base.

results.name: input_time_base_resync
results.evidence: Identical QueryPerformanceCounter -> __allmul -> __alldiv sequence as FUN_0048b3e0 but only updates DAT_00712538, with no table clear.
results.summary: Recomputes the millisecond input time base from QueryPerformanceCounter without resetting the rest of the input state.

results.name: input_update_tick
results.evidence: Calls FUN_00490ca0 (expire key-repeat timers) then FUN_00490b50 three times filling DAT_007127d0[0..2], then evaluates DAT_00712542 flags and dispatches to FUN_0048cca0/FUN_0048ec50/FUN_0048f8c0, the same bind-capture state machine seen in effect_new_on_object_marker.
results.summary: Per-frame input tick: expires repeat timers, samples three special button states, and dispatches the control-rebinding capture state machine.

results.name: input_bind_capture_dispatch
results.evidence: Body is register-parameter (in_ZF/in_EAX/unaff_EDI) duplicate of the tail switch in FUN_0048b4b0, dispatching to FUN_0048cca0 (apply), FUN_0048ec50 (start capture, +200ms deadline) or FUN_0048f8c0 (scan for any input); the inherited name effect_new_on_object_marker does not match this input-only code.
results.summary: Shared tail of the rebind-capture state machine (idle/start/reset/scan) reached with the flag word and deadline already in registers; wrongly named effect_new_on_object_marker by a prior pass.

results.name: input_bind_capture_reset
results.evidence: Zeroes the accumulator fields 00712498..7124bc (same fields FUN_0048cca0 fills) and sets DAT_00712540=1, the 'active capture' flag toggled elsewhere.
results.summary: Clears the current-frame input accumulator and marks the bind-capture state as freshly reset.

results.name: input_keyboard_set_capture_mode
results.evidence: Toggles bit 2 of DAT_00712542 from in_AL, then on the keyboard device DAT_006b1800 calls vtable+0x28 (IDirectInputDevice::SetProperty, DIPROP index 0x14) and clears the two 0x1b-byte key-state arrays 006b168d and 006b1620.
results.summary: Switches the keyboard device between normal and capture (rebind) property mode and clears the per-key press/hold state arrays.

results.name: input_axis_bindings_load_profile
results.evidence: When in_AL==0 clears the 0xa0-dword axis-binding table at DAT_00712544; otherwise sets bit 3 of DAT_00712542 and, per joystick device index, copies either the device's own profile (DAT_006b2a68 array) or the shared default profile (DAT_006b2cf8) into that table, gated by DAT_006b15f9 (use-defaults flag).
results.summary: Loads either per-device joystick axis binding profiles or the default profile into the active axis-binding table.

results.name: hs_bind_control
results.evidence: Parses a device/input string via FUN_0048fea0, an action name via FUN_0048fe60, applies the binding with FUN_0048b7b0, then prints console feedback 'bound %s %s to game control %s' via FUN_004c6860.
results.summary: Implements the console/script 'bind' command: parses a device input and an action name and writes the binding, then echoes confirmation.

results.name: input_apply_control_binding
results.evidence: Given a parsed binding descriptor (*in_ECX: type 1=key,2=mouse,3=joystick, plus device/axis/direction subfields) writes the game-control id (unaff_BX) into the matching table: DAT_00710330 (keys), DAT_0071040a/0071041a/0071041c (mouse buttons/axes), DAT_00710426/00710536/00710538/00710736 (joystick buttons/axes).
results.summary: Writes a parsed device-input descriptor's game-control assignment into the appropriate keyboard/mouse/joystick binding table.

results.name: hs_unbind_control
results.evidence: Parses the device string with FUN_0048fea0, clears the binding via FUN_0048b9b0, then prints one of the 'unbound %s ...' strings depending on the resolved device/subtype, mirroring hs_bind_control's structure.
results.summary: Implements the console/script 'unbind' command: parses a device input, clears its binding, and prints an 'unbound ...' confirmation.

results.name: input_clear_control_binding
results.evidence: Mirrors FUN_0048b7b0's table selection (type 1/2/3, same DAT_00710330/0071040a/00710426/00710536/00710538/00710736 tables) but always stores the unbound sentinel 0x7fff instead of a control id.
results.summary: Clears (unbinds) a device input's game-control assignment in the matching keyboard/mouse/joystick binding table.

results.name: input_find_control_binding_for_event
results.evidence: Given a device class in_ECX (0=keyboard/mouse, 1..4=joystick N) and a raw code unaff_SI, searches DAT_00710330/0071040a/0071041a (device 0) or DAT_00710426/00710536/00710538/00710736 (joystick), and on a hit writes a 12-byte 'last used binding' record into the DAT_007127d4 table indexed by the resolved control id.
results.summary: Resolves a raw keyboard/mouse/joystick input event to the game control it is bound to and records that binding as the control's most recently used input.

results.name: input_get_control_last_used_binding
results.evidence: Reads the 12-byte record at DAT_007127d4+param*0xc for control index in_AX; if unset, repeatedly calls FUN_0048bae0 (up to 5 times) to populate it, then copies the record out to param_1.
results.summary: Returns the input device/type most recently used to activate a given game control, populating the cache via FUN_0048bae0 if not yet known.

results.name: input_set_control_last_used_binding
results.evidence: For control index in_CX (0..0x1a) writes (or clears, if in_EAX==NULL) the 12-byte record at DAT_007127d4+in_CX*0xc from the 3 dwords pointed to by in_EAX, the same record layout produced by FUN_0048bae0/FUN_0048b7b0.
results.summary: Directly sets or clears the cached 'last used input device' record for a given game control.

results.name: input_print_bound_controls
results.evidence: Iterates DAT_00710330 (keys), DAT_0071040a (mouse buttons), and further mouse-axis/joystick tables, resolving display names via tag lookups ('controls_mouse_button_names' etc.) and printing '%s key bound to %s' / '%s mouse button bound to %s' / '%s mouse axis bound to %s' / '%s on gamepad %d bound to %s' via FUN_00496a80.
results.summary: Console/debug routine that lists every currently bound keyboard, mouse, and joystick input alongside the game control it triggers.

results.name: input_control_binding_text
results.evidence: Switches on a binding descriptor's type field (*in_EAX: 1=key,2=mouse,3=joystick) and subtype, dispatching to FUN_00490e30/FUN_00490f20/FUN_00491010 (name getters) or chimera-hinted FUN_00491270/FUN_00491340/FUN_004914c0 (joystick button/axis/pov text).
results.summary: Given a device-input descriptor, dispatches to the correct per-device name/text formatting routine (keyboard key, mouse button/axis, or joystick button/axis/pov).

results.name: input_axis_clamp01
results.evidence: Clamps a float to the [0.0,1.0] range and returns it; used by nearby DAT_00672ac0/00672ac4 sensitivity setters.
results.summary: Clamps a floating-point input value to the 0..1 range.

results.name: input_sensitivity_to_turnrate
results.evidence: Clamps param_1 to [0.001,100.0] then multiplies by 0.006283186 (~= 2*pi/1000), converting a sensitivity setting to a per-tick turn-rate/radian scale.
results.summary: Converts a raw sensitivity value into a clamped radians-per-unit turn-rate scale factor.

results.name: input_joystick_set_axis_scale_x
results.evidence: For controller index in_CX (0..3) clamps param_1 to [0,1] and stores it into a per-controller struct at DAT_00710b58 (stride 0x85c), paired with FUN_0048c9a0 writing DAT_00710b5c.
results.summary: Sets a per-joystick clamped 0..1 scale value (likely X-axis sensitivity/deadzone) for the given controller slot.

results.name: input_joystick_set_axis_scale_y
results.evidence: Identical to FUN_0048c930 but writes DAT_00710b5c instead of DAT_00710b58, at the same per-controller stride 0x85c.
results.summary: Sets a per-joystick clamped 0..1 scale value (likely Y-axis sensitivity/deadzone) for the given controller slot.

results.name: input_accumulate_axis_value
results.evidence: Switches on a control id in_DX in the 0x13-0x1a range, adding/subtracting a per-object increment (in_EAX+0x810.. fields) into an accumulator struct (in_ECX+0x14/0x18/0x1c/0x20), clamped to [-1,1]; reused from the main per-frame binding loops (FUN_0048cca0, FUN_0048ec50, hs_return-labeled function).
results.summary: Accumulates a digitally-pressed control's contribution into the corresponding movement/look axis accumulator, clamped to [-1,1].

results.name: input_mouse_sensitivity_curve_evaluate
results.evidence: Rebuilds a per-entry lookup table (calls FUN_006391b4 to fill 0x1c entries) whenever DAT_006894d0 (current sensitivity setting) changes, then interpolates against param_2 (a raw movement magnitude) to produce a scaled output, matching a mouse-acceleration curve pattern.
results.summary: Evaluates the mouse-sensitivity/acceleration response curve for a given raw movement magnitude, rebuilding the curve table when the sensitivity setting changes.

results.name: input_compute_action_values
results.evidence: Copies the accumulator snapshot from DAT_00712498, iterates all bound keys via DAT_00710330 calling FUN_0048ca10-style accumulation for control ids 0x13-0x1a, then loops up to 4 joystick devices' buttons/axes/povs recording last-used bindings into DAT_007127d4, and finishes by checking FUN_0048fce0 (idle detection, clears DAT_00712540) and FUN_0048fd60 (applies look-invert to _DAT_007124b8).
results.summary: The main per-frame routine that reads every bound keyboard, mouse, and joystick input and produces the final movement/look action accumulator values, also tracking idle state and look inversion.

results.name: input_apply_binding_delta
results.evidence: Currently named hs_return by a prior pass but the code has no script/HS behaviour: it walks the mouse-binding table DAT_0071040a and a per-device joystick axis/button delta (stack params) mapping control ids 0x13-0x1a to the same _DAT_007124ac/b0/b4/b8 accumulators used by FUN_0048cca0 and FUN_0048ca10, and records last-used bindings into DAT_007127d4 -- clearly an input-accumulation helper, not the Halo Script 'return' opcode.
results.summary: Applies a single device's per-frame input delta (mouse table entry plus buffered joystick axis/button events) into the shared movement/look accumulators; misnamed hs_return by an earlier pass and renamed here based on the code.

results.name: input_generate_double_tap_events
results.evidence: Scans bound movement/modifier keys for repeated presses within GetDoubleClickTime() of each other (cases matching control ids 0x13/0x17, 0x14/0x18, 0x15/0x19, 0x16/0x1a) and, on a detected double-tap, calls FUN_00492340 with an encoded event code; also emits keyboard/mouse/gamepad button events the same way.
results.summary: Detects double-tap presses of the bound movement keys/buttons within the system double-click interval and posts corresponding input events.

results.name: input_scan_any_bound_input
results.evidence: Scans up to 4 joysticks' buttons, then ~0x6d keyboard/mouse states via FUN_00490b50, then joystick axis deltas against saved defaults (threshold 0x4cc) and axis positions/povs, writing a detected-input record (device/type/index/sign) into DAT_007127c4/DAT_007127c8/DAT_007127cc.
results.summary: Waits for and detects the next raw input activation (any key, mouse button/axis, joystick button/axis/pov) for use by the control-rebinding capture UI.

results.name: input_accumulator_unchanged
results.evidence: Compares four float fields (offsets 0x14/0x18/0x1c/0x20, the same layout used by FUN_0048ca10's accumulator) between in_ECX and in_EDX against a 0.1 threshold, then checks 0x13 bytes of press-counters for all-zero, returning true only if nothing changed.
results.summary: Returns true when the input accumulator's axis values and press counters are unchanged from the previous snapshot (used to detect input idle state).

results.name: input_should_invert_look
results.evidence: Validates a player/object index, calls object_try_and_get(3) to get the controlled object, then reads the unit definition tag (via DAT_0087bc14/DAT_008603b0) and tests a seat/flag bit (mask 4) on the unit's seat data, returning true when it should be inverted.
results.summary: Determines whether look-Y input should be inverted for the player's currently controlled object/seat, based on the unit definition tag flags.

results.name: input_action_name_to_index
results.evidence: Linearly scans a 16-byte-stride action-name string table starting at DAT_0065b730 (first entry 'jump', extends to DAT_0065b8e0, near the 'switch_grenade' string reference) comparing case-insensitively to unaff_EBX, returning the matching control id.
results.summary: Resolves a textual game-control/action name (e.g. from a 'bind' command) to its numeric control id via case-insensitive string table lookup.

results.name: input_parse_device_binding_string
results.evidence: Compares unaff_EDI case-insensitively against 'keyboard'/'mouse'/'mouseaxis'/'joystick'/'joystickaxis'/'joystickpov' and dispatches to the matching per-device index lookup (FUN_00490ea0/FUN_00490f90/FUN_004910c0/FUN_004912e0/FUN_004913e0/FUN_00491590), filling a binding descriptor for the bind/unbind commands.
results.summary: Parses a device-class name string (keyboard/mouse/mouseaxis/joystick/joystickaxis/joystickpov) and its input name into a structured binding descriptor.

results.name: input_set_control_binding_record
results.evidence: Writes the 5-field, 0xc-byte binding record at DAT_007127d4+in_AX*0xc from register/stack arguments, the same layout produced by FUN_0048bae0/FUN_0048b7b0/FUN_0048be50; called directly from FUN_0048bae0's mouse-axis branch.
results.summary: Low-level setter that writes a control's 'last used binding' record fields directly.

results.name: test_input_device_defaults_find
results.evidence: Matches the inherited cea-pdb naming hint via its exact strings 'deviceid %s has no default' and 'Default profile in tag %d', calling FUN_00490110 to search default-profile tags.
results.summary: Debug/test routine that looks up a device's default control profile tag by device id and prints whether one was found.

results.name: input_device_default_profile_tag_find
results.evidence: Iterates all tags via tag_iterator_next, filters to header types 0/1 (device-profile tag groups), compares a 16-byte device-id block against the tag's stored id, and on match copies a 0x7ff-dword config block to the output buffer.
results.summary: Searches loaded tags for the default control-binding profile matching a given device id and copies its configuration data out.

results.name: input_apply_named_device_default_profile
results.evidence: Iterates tags of header type 2 comparing a wide device-name string via __wcsicmp, then resolves a player index with FUN_00539ab0, fetches the player's profile with player_profile_get, applies it with FUN_00490280, and saves it via player_profile_save_539bf0.
results.summary: Finds the tag matching a named input device and, if found, applies and saves its default binding profile onto the active player.

results.name: input_profile_copy_bindings_by_device
results.evidence: Branches on a device-category selector (in_EAX: 0,1,2,-1) copying disjoint byte ranges of a large binding-profile struct from unaff_EBX to in_EDX (e.g. offsets 0x134-0x226 for keyboard/mouse, 0x22a-0x1108+ for joystick), always finishing with a shared tail copy at 0x93c-0x948 and 0x12e-0x132.
results.summary: Copies control-binding profile data between two profile structs, selecting which device-specific sub-ranges (keyboard/mouse vs joystick) to copy based on a category code.

results.name: input_directinput_initialize
results.evidence: Calls the function pointer at DAT_00746268 with args matching DirectInputCreate(hinstance, 0x800, &IID, &lplpDirectInput, NULL) (string 'DirectInputCreate' referenced for the error path), then on success creates keyboard/mouse/joystick devices (FUN_004918a0/FUN_004919c0/FUN_00491a80) and acquires them (FUN_00490620).
results.summary: Creates the DirectInput object and the keyboard, mouse, and joystick device objects, then acquires them; logs and tears down on failure.

results.name: input_directinput_release_devices
results.evidence: For each of 8 joystick device pointers (DAT_006b1848 array) and the mouse (DAT_006b1804) and keyboard (DAT_006b1800) device pointers, calls vtable+0x20 (Unacquire) then vtable+8 (Release) and nulls the pointer; also releases the DirectInput object DAT_006b15fc.
results.summary: Unacquires and releases all DirectInput device objects (joysticks, mouse, keyboard) and the DirectInput object itself.

results.name: input_directinput_acquire_devices
results.evidence: Sets DAT_006b15f8=1 and calls vtable+0x1c (Acquire) on the keyboard (DAT_006b1800), mouse (DAT_006b1804, with a GetProperty buffer-size query), and all 8 joystick devices, logging failures with strings 'Acquire (keyboard)'/'Acquire (mouse)'/'Acquire (gamepad)'.
results.summary: Acquires the keyboard, mouse, and all connected joystick DirectInput devices and marks input as active.

results.name: input_directinput_unacquire_devices
results.evidence: Calls vtable+0x20 (Unacquire) on all 8 joystick devices, the mouse device (DAT_006b1804), and the keyboard device (DAT_006b1800), clearing DAT_006b15f8, with matching 'Unacquire (gamepad)'/'Unacquire (mouse)'/'Unacquire (keyboard)' error strings.
results.summary: Unacquires the keyboard, mouse, and joystick DirectInput devices without releasing them, marking input as inactive.

results.name: input_directinput_poll_devices
results.evidence: Reads keyboard buffered data via vtable+0x28 (GetDeviceData) on DAT_006b1800 updating the DAT_006b1620 key-hold array (with 'keyboard_buffer_overflow' handling), then polls the mouse device DAT_006b1804 via vtable+0x24 (GetDeviceState) with FUN_00491bc0 processing the result, and continues into joystick polling (truncated) guarded by GetAsyncKeyState for Alt/print-screen handling.
results.summary: Per-frame poll of the keyboard, mouse, and joystick DirectInput devices, updating the raw press/hold state arrays and handling device-lost reacquire and buffer overflow.

results.name: input_reset_state_and_axis_configs
results.evidence: Clears the keyboard hold/press arrays (006b1620, 006b168d), the mouse delta counters (006b16fa/fc/fe..), and the mouse-button/axis default table (006b180c..), then copies the default axis-binding profile (DAT_006b2cf8) into three additional per-joystick config slots (006b2a68, 006b2b08, 006b2ba8, 006b2c48).
results.summary: Resets keyboard, mouse, and joystick runtime input state and reseeds each joystick's axis-binding configuration from the default profile.

results.name: input_get_button_state
results.evidence: For special control ids (in_CX-0x6e in 0..3) returns held-duration-style values from DAT_006b1659/1664/1665/166c etc with a hysteresis compare, otherwise searches a special-key table DAT_006b1604 or falls back to the raw key array DAT_006b1620[in_CX]; called from 8 sites across the capture/update routines.
results.summary: Returns the current pressed/held state for a control id, special-casing a small set of hysteresis-tracked controls before falling back to the raw keyboard hold array.

results.name: input_key_repeat_timer_set
results.evidence: Finds a free or lowest-deadline slot in the 4-entry DAT_006b1600 timer table (each an absolute-ms deadline plus a control id), stores now()+param_1 and unaff_DI as the control id, and clears the matching entry in DAT_007127d0 against the DAT_0068e40c lookup table.
results.summary: Schedules a key-repeat expiry timer for a given control, reusing the oldest free slot in the fixed 4-entry timer table.

results.name: input_key_repeat_timers_expire
results.evidence: Walks the same DAT_006b1600 timer table as FUN_00490bf0 and, for any entry whose stored deadline has passed (compared against the current QueryPerformanceCounter-derived millisecond time), resets it to the free sentinel 0xffffffff/0xffff.
results.summary: Expires any key-repeat timers in the fixed timer table whose deadline has passed, freeing their slots.

results.name: input_record_windows_key_message
results.evidence: Handles WM_KEYDOWN/WM_SYSKEYDOWN (0x100/0x104, via the vkey->scancode table DAT_0065ba58) and WM_CHAR/WM_SYSCHAR (0x102/0x106, via DAT_0065bc58), reads Shift/Ctrl/Alt via GetKeyState, and appends the encoded scan-code+modifier entry into the circular buffer DAT_006b16fe (capacity 0x40, count DAT_006b16fc).
results.summary: WndProc-driven handler that records a Windows keyboard message (key or character) with its modifier state into the text/bind-capture input buffer.

results.name: input_get_mouse_control_active
results.evidence: Returns byte DAT_006b1818[param_1] only when the mouse device DAT_006b1804 is present and DAT_006b15f9 (use-default-profile flag) is clear, otherwise 0.
results.summary: Returns whether a given mouse-bound control is currently active, gated on the mouse device being present and not in default-profile mode.

results.name: input_get_keyboard_key_name
results.evidence: Looks up the reflexive array of the 'controls_keyboard_button_names' tag via tag_lookup, bounds-checks in_AX against the array length, and copies up to 0x18 wide characters into the caller's buffer via _wcsncpy.
results.summary: Fetches the display name string for a given keyboard key index from the keyboard-button-names tag.

results.name: input_keyboard_key_name_to_index
results.evidence: Iterates key indices calling FUN_00490e30 to get each key's display name, converts it to an ASCII string, and returns the first index whose name case-insensitively matches param_1.
results.summary: Resolves a keyboard key display name string back to its numeric key index by scanning the keyboard-button-names tag.

results.name: input_get_mouse_button_name
results.evidence: Identical structure to FUN_00490e30 but looks up the 'controls_mouse_button_names' tag instead.
results.summary: Fetches the display name string for a given mouse button index from the mouse-button-names tag.

results.name: input_mouse_button_name_to_index
results.evidence: Same pattern as FUN_00490ea0 but calls FUN_00490f20 and bounds the search to 8 entries, matching mouse button count.
results.summary: Resolves a mouse button display name string back to its numeric button index.

results.name: input_get_mouse_axis_name
results.evidence: Looks up 'controls_mouse_button_names' tag entry at index param_1+8 (the axis-name range past the button names) for the base name, then appends a space and the axis-direction suffix from FUN_00491180.
results.summary: Builds the display name for a mouse axis by combining the tag-provided axis name with its direction suffix.

results.name: input_mouse_axis_name_to_index
results.evidence: Iterates axis index (0..2) and direction (0/1), builds each candidate name via FUN_00491010, and returns the axis index (with direction written to param_2) whose formatted name case-insensitively matches param_1.
results.summary: Resolves a mouse axis-plus-direction display name string back to its axis index and direction.

results.name: input_get_axis_direction_name
results.evidence: Looks up the reflexive array of the 'controls_axis_direction_names' tag, bounds-checks in_AX, and copies up to 9 wide characters into the caller's buffer.
results.summary: Fetches the display name (e.g. '+'/'-') for a given axis direction index from the axis-direction-names tag.

results.name: input_axis_direction_name_to_index
results.evidence: Same lookup pattern as FUN_00490ea0 but calls FUN_00491180 and only checks 2 entries, matching the two axis directions.
results.summary: Resolves an axis-direction display name string back to its numeric direction index (0 or 1).

results.name: input_joystick_button_text
results.evidence: Looks up the 'controls_gamepad_names' tag reflexive array and formats a joystick button's display text via FUN_00557910; the callee name hint 'chimera__button_text' comes from a prior pass and is replaced here per naming convention.
results.summary: Builds the display text for a joystick button using the gamepad-names tag.

results.name: input_joystick_sbutton_name_to_index
results.evidence: Uses FUN_00625430 (string/data-block lookup) against the 'sbutton' string, then scans a decimal-suffix table at DAT_0065b988..0065b9e8 comparing to the parsed value.
results.summary: Resolves a system-button ('sbuttonN') style joystick input name string back to its numeric index.

results.name: input_joystick_axis_text
results.evidence: Looks up 'controls_gamepad_names' tag for the base axis name, gets the direction suffix via FUN_00491180, and formats '%s%d %s' through FUN_00557910; matches the chimera-hinted axis text helper pattern.
results.summary: Builds the display text for a joystick axis, combining the tag axis name, axis index, and direction suffix.

results.name: input_joystick_axis_name_to_index
results.evidence: Scans data blocks via FUN_00625430 starting at DAT_0065b988 up to DAT_0065b9e8, and for each candidate resolves the direction suffix with FUN_004911f0, returning the axis index and direction (*param_1) on a match.
results.summary: Resolves a joystick axis-plus-direction name string back to its numeric axis index and direction flag.

results.name: input_joystick_pov_direction_name_to_index
results.evidence: Linearly scans a 10-byte-stride compass-direction name table starting at DAT_0065b988 with entries 'north'/'northeast'/... comparing case-insensitively to unaff_EBX.
results.summary: Resolves a POV-hat compass direction name (north, northeast, ...) back to its numeric direction index.

results.name: input_joystick_pov_text
results.evidence: Looks up 'controls_gamepad_names' tag twice (once for the base gamepad name, once via the direction-name range at param_2+3) and formats '%s%d %s' through FUN_00557910, mirroring input_joystick_axis_text's structure for POV hats.
results.summary: Builds the display text for a joystick POV-hat input, combining the tag gamepad name, axis index, and compass direction.
